So this is how it ends, huh. It’s almost 0°F. All I got is the rest of my bed and a few rags that I covered up myself with. 
My sexbot is broken. She will not start up no matter what. She looks alright outside, but something must have broken inside. 
Brrrr, I’m freezing here… I have no power to move or even be angry anymore…
I couldn’t go back to my mom’s place because the last train to home had already left. I can’t just leave my stuff here anyway...
I will try to go to sleep for now. Maybe it will help me with the cold. 
{{s=60}}I will figure {{s=30}}out something {{s=20}} tomorrow… {{wi}}{{s=15}}for sure…
